howToExport: In Revolut, pick the currency account you're bookkeeping: one QuickBooks bank account per Revolut currency keeps balances honest.
Open its Statement option, choose the spreadsheet format rather than PDF, and select the accounting period.
Download the CSV and drop it above; it needs no manual edits first.
knownQuirks: The Type column (CARD_PAYMENT, TOPUP, TRANSFER, EXCHANGE…) carries the context QuickBooks bank rules need, but in shouting case; the preset appends it to the description as readable text.
Top-ups from your own bank look like income in the CSV; in QuickBooks they should be matched as transfers, not recorded as sales.
Each currency exchange creates a row in each currency. With one QuickBooks account per currency, upload each side to its own account by picking the currency in the selector.
Started Date and Completed Date both include a time; QuickBooks wants one plain date column, so the settled Completed Date is used.
